nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Three ways. Strand brings soldiers and the depot kit. She'll own it after.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Bea Salvesen at the docks brings strong backs. And she'll own it too. Just friendlier.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Or we go alone. Walk twenty miles of river in January. Owe nobody.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Me? I'd go alone and die proud. Which is why you shouldn't ask me.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Your call, kid. Your boy's the one on insulin.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Lou keys the Authority frequency. Strand answers in four seconds.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Four seconds. She's been waiting for somebody like us.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Lou relays to the ore docks. Bea comes on laughing: 'Here's the deal. Yes.'

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: She'll want a vote on what color the lights are. Fine.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Good. Then pack like you mean it. We go in six weeks, after the deep cold breaks.
